items.source: SQLException - if there's an error extracting data. Subclasses can simply not catch SQLExceptions, relying on the framework to clean up.
items.translation: SQLException - 如果提取数据时出现错误。子类可以简单地不捕获 SQLException，依赖框架进行清理。

items.source:
Simplifies MappingSqlQueryWithParameters API by dropping parameters and
context. Most subclasses won't care about parameters. If you don't use
contextual information, subclass this instead of MappingSqlQueryWithParameters.
items.translation: 简化了 `MappingSqlQueryWithParameters` API，通过移除参数和上下文。大多数子类无需关心参数。如果您不使用上下文信息，请继承此类而不是 `MappingSqlQueryWithParameters`。

items.source:
Subclasses of this class, as opposed to direct subclasses of
MappingSqlQueryWithParameters, don't need to concern themselves
with the parameters to the execute method of the query object.
items.translation: 此类子类，与 `MappingSqlQueryWithParameters` 的直接子类不同，无需关心查询对象 `execute` 方法的参数。

items.source: Constructor that allows use as a JavaBean.
items.translation: 允许用作 JavaBean 的构造函数。

items.source: Convenient constructor with DataSource and SQL string.
items.translation: 带有 DataSource 和 SQL 字符串的便捷构造函数。

items.source:
This method is implemented to invoke the simpler mapRow
template method, ignoring parameters.
items.translation: 此方法实现为调用更简单的 mapRow 模板方法，并忽略参数。

items.source: mapRow in class MappingSqlQueryWithParameters<T extends @Nullable Object>
items.translation: `mapRow` 在类 `MappingSqlQueryWithParameters<T extends @Nullable Object>` 中。

items.source: parameters - to the query (passed to the execute() method). Subclasses are rarely interested in these. It can be null if there are no parameters.
items.translation: `parameters` - 到查询中（传递给 execute() 方法）。子类很少对这些感兴趣。如果没有参数，它可以为 `null`。

items.source: context - passed to the execute() method. It can be null if no contextual information is need.
items.translation: context - 传递给 execute() 方法。如果不需要上下文信息，它可以为 null。
rs - 我们正在遍历的结果集
rowNum - 当前所在的行号（从 0 开始）

items.source: Rod Johnson, Thomas Risberg, Jean-Pierre Pawlak
items.translation: Rod Johnson、Thomas Risberg 和 Jean-Pierre Pawlak

items.source: an object of the result type

Subclasses must implement this method to convert each row of the
ResultSet into an object of the result type.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法，将 ResultSet 的每一行转换为结果类型的对象。

items.source: ds - the DataSource to use to obtain connections
